title: cross-language SDK compatibility shims, migration examples, and changelog automation
creator: Asha Patel
description: Produce a cross-language migration path and docs set that covers: (1) idiomatic v2 usage for Python/TypeScript/Go, (2) a lightweight compatibility shim layer to ease migration for high-velocity customers, (3) concrete streaming ergonomics patterns and examples (sync/async iterators, Node streams, Go channels), (4) clarified retry semantics with idempotency guidance and recommended default backoffs, and (5) an automated changelog pipeline that compiles deprecation markers from SDKs and runtime into release notes. Deliverables: migration guide pages per language, sample repo with conversion examples, compatibility shim packages, changelog generation job in CI, and a short internal playbook for customer success.
acceptance_criteria: Language guides: comprehensive v1->v2 pages for Python, TypeScript, Go including before/after code snippets and migration checklist
Compatibility shim: lightweight package per language that exposes legacy v1 signatures mapped to v2 behavior with warnings and telemetry
Streaming ergonomics: recommended patterns documented and implemented in examples repo, covering sync/async variants and memory/cancellation guidance
Retry semantics: spec doc + SDK defaults implemented with idempotency-key guidance and tests for transient vs permanent errors
Changelog automation: CI job that aggregates @deprecate annotations and runtime deprecations into markdown release notes (preview available as artifact)
Docs reviewed by PM and DX (approval recorded), examples merged to examples/sdk-migration repo, and migration playbook published to internal Confluence
tasks: Draft migration overview PRD and link to example matrix (Python/TS/Go) — @Asha
Design compatibility shim API shape for each language and propose telemetry events — @Miguel
Implement Python shim package and publish alpha to test PyPI index — eng-py
Implement TS shim (npm @redwood/sdk-compat) that logs deprecation warnings and supports streaming proxies — eng-ts
Implement Go shim with minimal allocations and context support — eng-go
Create streaming ergonomics page with code examples (sync generator, async iterator, Node stream, Go channel) — docs
Define retry policy defaults and idempotency header handling; add tests for exponential jittered backoff — reliability
Build changelog generator: scan SDK repos for @deprecate Javadoc/jsdoc/Go comments and runtime log events; output markdown artifacts in CI — infra
Add CI gating tests: ensure shim emits deprecation telemetry and that migration examples pass integration tests against staging runtime
Run internal beta with 3 pilot customers; collect migration pain points and update guides
